sup:70710.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We appreciate the cost pressures you describe, and the binding volume set out below covers our full demand for this part, all placed with you; our forecast is rising, and the longer contract term offers planning security. As you secured material forward at fixed prices, could the owner walk us through how the cost movements inform the proposed base price and alloy surcharge?

We confirm a binding volume of 94800 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Your letter of 2026-07-06 (doc:20260706-70710-M1) says your material is covered at fixed prices, so recent index movements do not reach your costs yet.
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 5.45 (po:4500014455-10, po:4500014391-10, po:4500014305-10).
In our call of 2026-04-21 (doc:20260421-70710-M2) you offered to walk us through your calculation; we would welcome that now.

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.76 per unit, fixed price, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 94800 units a year over 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.43 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We appreciate the binding volume of 94800 units over 36 months and would welcome a meeting to walk through our pricing basis.
As our fixed-price material coverage does not extend for the full duration of the requested contract, we must include an AS-14404 index clause.
Incorporating your requested 90-day payment terms, we can offer a revised price of EUR 5.55 per unit.
Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.55 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken; we appreciate it.

The binding volume stands as stated below and is our full demand for this part over the contract term, all with you; our forecast is rising, and the long term provides a reliable basis for planning. We are moving our proposal toward you again, while noting that your material was purchased forward at fixed prices; we would welcome the calculation walkthrough your owner previously offered.

We confirm a binding volume of 94800 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our forecast for this part is up 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.96 per unit, price follows AS-14404 on 45% of the price, deadband 0%, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 94800 units a year over 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
